main_text.l: [Engraving: oval portrait of Philippus III with legend "PHILIPPVS III. DEI GRATIA HISPANIARVM ET INDIARVM REX etc." around it; described under notes.]
Tertius obtinui Regnorum sceptra PhilippusDiuitiis de Marte potens, mihi decolor IndusEt tumidus mihi paret Iber, mihi perfidus hostisSeruit, & indomiti submittunt colla Sicambri.

page.notes: The oval engraving carries the legend "PHILIPPVS III. DEI GRATIA HISPANIARVM ET INDIARVM REX etc." running around its border. The verse caption is set in italic type. The signature mark is "S 4". The verse is transcribed as printed; "Tertius" and "obtinui" as read from the scan. The line "Seruit, & indomiti submittunt colla Sicambri" is read with some uncertainty in its last word.
